description: This source file implements functions related to selecting groups and instances within a GUI or terminal interface for managing Android virtual devices. It includes logic for default group selection, filtering, user prompts, and handling instance groups.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Template class encapsulating success or error state, used throughout for error handling.

classes.name: LocalInstanceGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of local instances, including their creation time, name, and contained instances.

classes.name: InstanceManager
classes.description: Provides methods to find, retrieve, and manage instance groups and instances.

classes.name: CommandRequest
classes.description: Represents a command input, including environment variables and selection options.

classes.name: InterruptibleTerminal
classes.description: Provides an interface to read user input with interruption support.

methods.name: Result<LocalInstanceGroup> GetDefaultGroup(const InstanceManager & instance_manager)
methods.description: Retrieves the default instance group, either the only one available or the one associated with the system-wide home.

methods.name: Result<InstanceDatabase::Filter> BuildFilterFromSelectors(const SelectorOptions & selectors,const cvd_common::Envs & env)
methods.description: Creates a filter object based on user-provided selectors and environment variables for querying instances.

methods.name: std::string SelectionMenu(const std::vector<LocalInstanceGroup> & groups)
methods.description: Generates a textual menu representing multiple instance groups for user selection.

methods.name: Result<LocalInstanceGroup> PromptUserForGroup(const InstanceManager & instance_manager,const CommandRequest & request,const cvd_common::Envs & envs,InstanceDatabase::Filter filter)
methods.description: Interactive function that prompts the user to select an instance group from a menu.

methods.name: Result<LocalInstanceGroup> FindGroupOrDefault(const InstanceDatabase::Filter & filter,const InstanceManager & instance_manager)
methods.description: Finds an instance group based on a filter, or retrieves the default if the filter is empty.

methods.name: Result<std::pair<LocalInstance,LocalInstanceGroup>> FindDefaultInstance(const InstanceManager & instance_manager)
methods.description: Finds the default instance along with its group, expecting exactly one in the default group.

methods.name: Result<LocalInstanceGroup> SelectGroup(const InstanceManager & instance_manager,const CommandRequest & request)
methods.description: Main exported function to select an instance group, either interactively or by default.

methods.name: Result<std::pair<LocalInstance,LocalInstanceGroup>> SelectInstance(const InstanceManager & instance_manager,const CommandRequest & request)
methods.description: Main exported function to select an instance, either default or based on filters.

ctags.signature: (const InstanceManager & instance_manager,const CommandRequest & request,const cvd_common::Envs & envs,InstanceDatabase::Filter filter)
